saw_lines: Hosting buyers pick on where data sits and who can reach it, then rarely move once a migration is done.
So the sale is won on the page, where a buyer checks location, security and certification before writing in.
Your site sells five services from a Hannover data center, so put the location and one real uptime or certification figure at the top of each service page.
ads_1: Paid creative: data sovereignty from Hannover, tested against managed services
soc_1: Brand social strategy for the channels your buyers already use
